verdict.rationale: Drata's public API v2 is documented, with OAuth setup and full CRUD for Custom Connections. It also offers 'Create Custom Monitoring Test' and Evidence Library create/update endpoints, and the developer portal explicitly pitches connecting on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection. Together these cover pushing evidence and tests from systems the catalog doesn't cover. Missing for 10: an explicit documented endpoint for pushing custom test-result data (it is only implied via custom tests and connections), a non-experimental resource-push path (the device push endpoint is marked 🧪), a downloadable OpenAPI spec (probes at common paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
